第33章 念念-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

吴姜看着她这副模样，心都要化了，忍不住伸出手，轻轻摸了摸她的小脑袋，笑着安抚：“嗯，大哥哥能看到你，也能帮你找到爸爸妈妈。跟我走，我带你去找他们，好不好？”

小女孩先是犹豫了一下，看了看吴姜温和的眼神，随后立刻用力点了点头：“好呀！谢谢大哥哥！”

顿了顿，她又仰着小脸，认真地说道：“我叫念念，大哥哥可以叫我念念哦！”

吴姜忍不住笑了，又摸了摸她的小脑袋，柔声道：“嗯，念念真乖，哥哥叫吴姜，明天哥哥就带你去找爸爸妈妈，好不好？”

吴姜心念一动，意识瞬间进入阴差令牌，从中取出了那枚聚灵吊坠。

这吊坠不仅能汇聚灵气，还能给鬼物提供容身之所，之前王家的那个女鬼，就是藏在这吊坠里，就连城隍庙里的阴神都找不到她。

他拿着聚灵吊坠，在念念面前轻轻晃了晃，温柔地说道：“念念，你先钻进这个吊坠里，这样哥哥就能带你离开这里了。”

念念似懂非懂地点了点头，吴姜不再犹豫，默念口诀，下一秒，念念的身影就化作一缕微光，钻进了聚灵吊坠里。

此刻，周围的人都像看傻子一样，看着吴姜，不知道哪里来的神经病，一个人蹲在那里自言自语。

李月芽此刻也走了过来，声音带着几分颤抖：“吴姜，你发病了？一个人在那里，自言自语，还对着空气摸来摸去。”

吴姜没有回答她的疑问，反而说道：“我们先走吧，出去了，再给你解释！”

李月芽虽然还是满肚子的疑惑，但还是乖乖的跟着去换衣服了。

吴姜这次不准备让李月芽开车了，担心她一会儿害怕，再将车开到沟里。

不是怕李月芽受伤，主要自己的是新车，他心疼。

等李月芽坐进副驾驶，吴姜才缓缓开口，把自己能看到鬼、刚才遇到小鬼念念的事情，用之前糊弄别人的说辞，简单跟她说了一遍。

李月芽听完，脸上露出了一副看二傻子的表情，意思很明显，你猜我信不信？

吴姜早就料到她不会轻易相信，耸了耸肩，伸出手，在她的左右肩膀上拍了拍，随后示意她往后看。

Chapter 33 Niannian - "The City God is my ancestor, it turns out that I am the Nth generation of gods"

Seeing her like this, Wu Jiang's heart almost melted. He couldn't help but reach out and gently touched her little head, smiling and comforting: "Well, big brother can see you and help you find your parents. Come with me, and I will take you to find them, okay?"

The little girl hesitated for a moment, looked at Wu Jiang's gentle eyes, and then immediately nodded vigorously: "Okay! Thank you, big brother!"

After a pause, she raised her little face again and said seriously: "My name is Nian Nian, big brother, you can call me Nian Nian!"

Wu Jiang couldn't help but laugh, touched her little head again, and said softly: "Well, Nian Nian is so good. My brother's name is Wu Jiang. I will take you to find your parents tomorrow, okay?"

With a thought in Wu Jiang's mind, his consciousness instantly entered the Yin Cha Token, and he took out the Soul Gathering Pendant from it.

This pendant can not only gather spiritual energy, but also provide a place for ghosts. The female ghost from the Wang family was hidden in this pendant. Even the Yin God in the City God's Temple could not find her.

He held the Soul-Gathering Pendant, shook it gently in front of Niannian, and said gently: "Niannian, you get into this pendant first, so that my brother can take you out of here."

Nian Nian nodded in understanding. Wu Jiang no longer hesitated and recited the mantra silently. The next second, Nian Nian's figure turned into a ray of light and got into the spirit-gathering pendant.

At this moment, everyone around him looked at Wu Jiang as if he were a fool. He didn't know where the madness came from, and he was squatting there talking to himself.

Li Yueya also walked over at this moment, her voice trembling: "Wu Jiang, are you sick? You are there alone, talking to yourself, and touching the air."

Wu Jiang did not answer her question, but said: "Let's go first. I'll explain to you after we get out!"

Although Li Yueya was still full of doubts, she still followed and changed clothes obediently.

Wu Jiang was not going to let Li Yueya drive this time because he was worried that she would get scared and drive the car into a ditch.

It wasn't that he was worried about Li Yueya getting hurt, but mainly that he was worried about his new car.

When Li Yueya got into the passenger seat, Wu Jiang slowly spoke and told her briefly about how he could see ghosts and how he had just met the little ghost Nian Nian, using the same rhetoric he used to fool others.

After listening to this, Li Yueya had an expression on her face that looked like a fool. The meaning was obvious. Do you think I believe it or not?

Wu Jiang had long expected that she would not believe it easily, so he shrugged, stretched out his hand, patted her left and right shoulders, and then motioned for her to look back.
